system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: We use the same system prompts across all models for consistency.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-layer prompts (DSPy signatures) with query/context variables; Appendix G.1 not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the LLM never receives raw glucose readings in its context window, it only aggregates the results from function calls
env_context_strategy.note: No repository context injected; only the user query plus tool results.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The LLM receives only these aggregated outputs (e.g., {avg_TIR_sufficient_weartime: 72%, days_sufficient_weartime: 4}), never the underlying time series.
observation_format.note: Tool returns structured aggregated metrics; trend visualization also generates plots but plot delivery to LLM not stated.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: For each sub-task, the LLM generates a function call specifying the operation and parameters (metric type, date range, reference thresholds).
tool_call_format.note: Implemented with DSPy ReAct; exact call syntax not shown in evidence.

tool_count.note: Full function signatures said to be in Appendix A, not included in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: the Python toolkit (Section 3.2) processes the user's CGM data and returns aggregated results
edit_primitive.note: Analytical read-only tools only; no file-editing tool.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: we developed a Python toolkit that serves two purposes: (1) generating ground-truth answers for benchmark queries, and (2) providing executable functions for the agent at inference time
tool_schema_source.note: DSPy tool signatures written by authors; auto-generation from signatures plausible but not evidenced.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: the LLM interacts with CGM data only through predefined tool interfaces
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mentioned anywhere in README or paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The pipeline consists of three layers: (1) the Input Processor resolves ambiguous queries, (2) the Analytical Agent generates tool calls executed in a local sandbox, and (3) the Response Generator synthesizes a natural language answer.
loop_primitives.note: Layer 2 is a DSPy ReAct loop (agent/impl/qa/react_qa.py).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The LLM decomposes such queries into a sequence of atomic sub-tasks, each mapped to a single function call.
planning_granularity.note: Decomposition in reasoning, no persisted plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: We propose a three-layer pipeline that separates LLM reasoning from data access.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Input Processor P validates feasibility, resolves temporal references, and maps vague terms to precise system features, producing a refined query q'.
delegation_mechanism.note: Fixed hand-off of the refined query between the three modules.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: this design naturally extends to interactive clarification on Input Processor, yielding further performance gains on ambiguous queries
human_in_loop.note: Main branch default has no HITL; interactive clarification is a supplementary branch.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: q P−−→q′ T−−−−−→ Tools(D) R G(q,q ′,R) −−−−−−→y
short_term_state.note: State is the query/refined query/results passed along; no typed state object evidenced.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: All computation occurs locally, and personal health data never leaves the user's device.
long_term_memory.note: No memory/skill component described in architecture (Sec. 4).

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The results of the experiments are saved in the `results/` directory, organized by experiment type and model name.
state_persistence.note: Results are written out; no resume path described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we use Gemini 3.0 Pro as an automated judge to assess function-call correctness and value matching
self_verification.note: Judge is part of the evaluation harness, not the runtime agent loop.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: For each sub-task, the LLM generates a function call specifying the operation and parameters
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry described in the pipeline.

rollback.evidence_quote: All numerical computation over CGM data occurs in a local execution sandbox.
rollback.note: Read-only analytics; nothing to roll back.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If the Input Processor determines that q is unanswerable (e.g., requires insulin logs), it generates an explanation e and the pipeline bypasses the Analytical Agent
termination_condition.note: Pipeline ends when the Response Generator emits an answer; DSPy ReAct max_iters not shown in evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: lightweight models achieve competitive performance in our agent design, suggesting opportunities for low-cost deployment
cost_controls.note: Model selectable per Hydra config (conf/model/*.yaml); no token budget or caching evidenced.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: This call is dispatched to the local execution sandbox, where the Python toolkit (Section 3.2) processes the user's CGM data and returns aggregated results.
execution_isolation.note: "Sandbox" denotes local in-process Python toolkit execution; no container evidenced.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: the LLM interacts with CGM data only through predefined tool interfaces, never directly accessing raw glucose readings
filesystem_access.note: Agent can only reach CGM data through fixed functions over cleaned_cgm/ files.

network_policy.evidence_quote: personal health data never leaves the user's device
network_policy.note: Tool actions are local computation only; LLM API calls are made by the harness, not by agent actions.

permission_model.evidence_quote: the LLM serves only as a reasoning engine that interprets user intent and selects appropriate analytical functions
permission_model.note: Only the predefined registered toolkit functions can be invoked.

tracing.evidence_quote: The results of the experiments are saved in the `results/` directory, organized by experiment type and model name.
tracing.note: Per-query logs/results files; format not shown in evidence.

replayability.evidence_quote: any system can verify answers by re-running the toolkit
replayability.note: Deterministic ground-truth re-execution, but no trajectory replay mechanism evidenced.

guardrails.evidence_quote: The Input Processor serves as a gatekeeper, performing two functions before any data access.
guardrails.note: Feasibility classification can block a query before any tool execution.

target_domain.evidence_quote: CGM-Agent, a privacy-preserving framework for question answering over personal glucose data
target_domain.note: Domain is personal health (CGM) data question answering.
